enrichment.headline: Lets The Watershed Project add a rainwater cistern, trees and a mural at Coliseum College Prep at no cost
enrichment.summary: This is a no-cost agreement (a memorandum of understanding) that lets The Watershed Project install a rainwater tank, new California native trees with irrigation, redwood benches and a planter, and a mural at Coliseum College Preparatory Academy.
